reason: The only offered action adds mineral to the collagen framework, plausibly strengthening the bones.
expectation: I expect a mineralized bone framework; it may still need cells, vessels and joint structures.

effect: The framework now has mineral, and the result clarifies collagen's toughness and mineral's resistance to compression. Bone cells are the next offered addition.
reaction: The contrast between flexible fibres and firmer mineral makes their complementary roles clear.
reason: Adding bone cells is the only offered combination and seems useful for making the framework living bone.
expectation: I expect the cells to become part of the mineralised framework, though vessels and joint structures will probably still be needed.

effect: Bone cells now occupy spaces in the matrix and connect through tiny channels that allow nutrients and signals to pass. The next offered addition is blood vessels.
reaction: The cutaway makes it interesting to see how cells stay connected inside hard bone.
reason: Adding blood vessels is the only offered combination and should help support the living bone cells.
expectation: I expect vessels to become part of the arm bones, though I am unsure how their connection to the cells will be shown.

effect: Vessels now supply nutrients toward the embedded bone cells through the channel network. The next offered addition is articular cartilage.
reaction: The distinction between blood cells staying in the vessel and nutrients leaving it is clear.
reason: The only offered combination adds cartilage to the living bones, likely helping the elbow move smoothly.
expectation: I expect cartilage to cap the bone ends at the elbow; the capsule and ligaments may still be needed.

effect: Cartilage now caps the facing elbow surfaces, with an inset showing them sliding. The next offered addition is the synovial capsule.
reaction: The sliding inset makes the cartilage's role clear.
reason: The only offered combination adds the capsule around the joint, likely supporting smooth movement.
expectation: I expect a fluid-containing sleeve around the elbow; the ligaments may still be needed for support.

effect: The capsule now encloses the joint, and its lining supplies fluid that helps the cartilage-covered surfaces glide.
reaction: The explanation clarifies why the fluid-filled capsule matters.
reason: The only offered combination adds ligaments, which appear suited to supporting the elbow.
expectation: I expect the ligaments to span the elbow and support the movable joint, possibly completing the goal.

effect: The ligaments complete the movable arm skeleton; the planned arrows distinguish elbow bending from resistance to sideways movement.
reaction: That contrast makes the ligaments' supporting role clear.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding blood vessels was most worthwhile: the planned cutaway connects the bone cells and their channels to nutrient delivery, while showing that blood cells stay in the vessel.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding cartilage and then the capsule felt somewhat sequential and predictable, especially with only one combination offered at each decision. The planned illustrations and capsule explanation still gave the steps a purpose.

surprise.text: The tiny channels connecting embedded bone cells changed my picture of hard bone as an isolated solid.

arbitrary.text: No addition felt purposeless, although the fixed sequence offered little room for meaningful choice. 'Articular' and 'synovial' were not explicitly defined; their planned pictures and subsequent results helped explain the structures.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in continuing to see how muscles pull on this skeleton, though the single-option sequence made the gameplay less compelling than the biological connections.
